name: Education Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Direct invitation from the Ministry, or from a Myanmar university/school, stating the duration of stay, plus a recommendation letter from the sponsoring institution.
Passport valid for at least 6 months, with available visa pages.

evidence_required.document: Fee paid by cashier's check or money order only (no cash/card/personal check)

outcome.duration_length: Single Education Visa: initial 90 days, extendable with evidence of continued enrollment, USD 50; Multiple Education Visa: up to 1 year validity, further extendable, USD 160 -- but NOT available to first-time applicants, who must start on the single-entry visa

sources.title: Consulate General of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, Los Angeles (official diplomatic mission) -- Education Visa: single-entry (90 days, extendable, USD 50) and multiple-entry (up to 1 year, USD 160, not available to first-time applicants), requires sponsoring-institution recommendation letter and a direct invitation from the Ministry or the Myanmar university/school

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Myanmar). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced from an official Myanmar diplomatic mission site. STRUCTURAL FINDING WORTH FLAGGING: first-time applicants are explicitly barred from the multiple-entry Education Visa and must start on the single-entry version -- an unusual two-tier gating structure not seen in most other countries' student routes in this dataset. Fees must be paid via cashier's check or money order specifically; no cash, credit card, or personal check accepted, per the source's own explicit wording. See ng_visitor_visa.json-equivalent political-context note in mm_visitor_visa.json -- the same SAC/civil-war caveats apply here: Myanmar's higher-education sector has also been significantly disrupted by the conflict, campus closures, and a large-scale 'Spring Revolution' student/civil-disobedience movement since 2021, which is likely to affect the practical reliability of any given institution's invitation-letter process, though this was not independently assessed in this build.
